outcome: The manifested card enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with no name, types beyond creature, or mana cost.
A manifested permanent can be turned face up for its mana cost only if its card is a creature card with a mana cost; it then regains its normal characteristics.
note: Choosing to turn it face up is a decision; whether the special action is permitted is a legality verdict.

outcome: A manifested card with morph can be turned face up by paying its morph cost as well as its mana cost.
note: Choosing the procedure is a decision; that the morph procedure is permitted is a legality verdict.

outcome: A manifested card with disguise can be turned face up by paying its disguise cost as well as its mana cost.
note: Choosing the procedure is a decision; that the disguise procedure is permitted is a legality verdict.

outcome: Several cards manifested from a library enter the battlefield face down one at a time.
If the face-down object is prohibited from entering the battlefield, the card stays in its previous zone with unmodified characteristics.
A manifested instant or sorcery that would turn face up stays face down and turned-face-up triggers do not fire.
